motivation: C87 raw rank-gap .20238 shrinks to .08632 under 1000 guide-count-balanced subsets. Their percentile range is not biological uncertainty. A target-cluster interval is necessary before interpreting residual agreement.
estimands: Average over all existing1000 balanced guide plans of equal3cell Spearman rank-agreement difference (older vs reused minus older vs fresh).
Average over all existing1000 balanced guide plans of equalproduct/3cell fresh-minus-reused LFC.
plans: Reuse exactly all2000 C87 target-cluster draws and all1000 C87 balanced guide choices, with no new random draws or filtering.
method: For each target-cluster draw compute each balanced-plan statistic on the complete duplicated product sample, then average all1000 plan estimates. Percentile97.5% intervals for two posthoc endpoints; retain undefined values and apply existing1% undefined gate. These are target-sampling intervals conditional on the fixed1000-plan approximation, not experimental replicates or a causal correction.
implementation: Weighted tied-midrank Spearman exactly represents duplicated products. Validate against explicit duplication using scipy.stats.spearmanr for the first20 cluster draws and first20 guide plans, all3cells and2newer groups.
MC_check: Retain all1000 point estimates and report first500 versus last500 plan-averaged point estimates and primary MCSE already saved. No selecting best subset or draw.
claim_limits: No equivalence conclusion from an interval containing zero.
Unequal counts are a measurement-precision explanation, not a proven exclusive cause.
